rules.when: The task is a trivial mechanical edit: a rote rename, formatting sweep, typo fix, file gathering, or a one-line config change with no judgment involved.
rules.why: Cheapest capable model for narrow, unambiguous work.

rules.when: The task is hard or ambiguous: a design or architecture decision, root-cause diagnosis of a subtle bug, a security-sensitive change, a risky refactor, an investigation whose conclusion could change what gets built, or work that has to hold many moving parts in mind.
rules.why: Strongest reasoning for work where a wrong call is expensive; pay for it only here.

rules.when: The task is a scout that reads, compares or summarises existing material into a report without changing code or needing deep reasoning: a literature or repo survey, an inventory, a reading of logs, a status scan.
rules.why: Reading and summarising does not need deep reasoning; a fast, cheap long-context model fits.
